generation_ack_protocol.grant_identity: receiver-local membership generation plus flow ID
generation_ack_protocol.ack_required_rule: a generation requires ACK closure when any flow is first granted or its encoded target is below its conservative acknowledged upper bound
generation_ack_protocol.ack_optional_rule: an otherwise optional pure-release generation sets ack_required=0 and emits no ACK
generation_ack_protocol.geometric_release_rule: an optional pure-release generation may emit only when its active count is at most floor(the previous emitted vector active count divided by two)
generation_ack_protocol.retry_semantics: retry only unacknowledged flows in the current ACK-required generation
generation_ack_protocol.terminal_condition: every ACK-required generation is fully acknowledged; every ACK-optional generation has zero pending/retry state

selection_policy: Qualify geometric release batching on frozen seed 107 before opening the five-seed holdout. Do not inspect pilot performance. Do not inspect holdout performance until every holdout mechanism check passes, and do not alter the configuration after seeing holdout results.

scalability_holdout.required_control_frame_envelope: F_s(N) = grant sends + grant-ACK sends < 3N for every coalesced seed and N

scope_limits: The pilot and holdout isolate membership changes by disabling remaining-aware progress refresh.
The first-grant gate bounds each new registered flow to one fixed BDP until an ACK-required generation-tagged grant arrives.
Optional pure-release vectors follow the frozen active<=floor(previous_active/2) geometric rule.
Passing F<3N supports only synchronized N<=15 membership traces, not general O(N).
Performance metrics remain sealed until every holdout mechanism admission check passes.
The V8 tools require simulator commit 51cabdd or a descendant, freeze guard_proactive_release=0, and fail closed if the geometric trace/stats/safety capability probe does not pass.
